name: The Orchid Show 2026: Christian Sampson
blurb: Selby Gardens' signature fall exhibition fills its bayfront conservatory with orchid installations by artist Christian Sampson. Admission is $28 for adults, $12 for ages 5–17, and free for members and kids 4 and under.
photo_credit: Photo: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens / Sarasota Magazine

name: Ahoy-Hoy by Jenny Stafford
hours_label: Wed–Sat 7:30 PM · Wed & Sun 2 PM · $52 ($32 under 40)
blurb: Urbanite Theatre, downtown Sarasota's intimate home for bold new plays, stages Jenny Stafford's Ahoy-Hoy. Standard tickets are $52, $32 for patrons under 40, and $5 for students with ID.

name: Sarasota Orchestra: Beethoven & Prokofiev with Gil Shaham
hours_label: Sat 7:30 PM · Sun 2:30 PM · Tickets from $43
blurb: Sarasota Orchestra opens its Masterworks season at the bayfront Van Wezel with star violinist Gil Shaham playing Beethoven's Violin Concerto, followed by Prokofiev's Symphony No. 5. Tickets start at $43.

name: Siesta Key Crystal Classic Sandsculpting Festival
hours_label: 10 AM – 5:30 PM (Sat until 9 PM) · Ticketed; Vendor Village free
blurb: Twenty master sand sculptors compete on Siesta Key's famous white sand, with demos, live music and lit-up sculptures on Saturday night. The sculpture area is ticketed, while the Vendor Village outside is free to stroll.
photo_credit: Photo: Siesta Key Crystal Classic / VisitSarasota.com
